failed.title: The sessions could not be read

problem.current: This is the browser you are using: sign out here with Sign out on this device.
problem.self: These are your own sessions: end them on My profile.
problem.forbidden: You may not do this here. Ask an administrator for the right.
problem.signedOut: Your session ended. Sign in again to go on.
problem.unavailable: The factory server did not answer. Try again in a moment.
problem.failed: Something went wrong. Try again; if it happens again, tell the administrator.

me.title: Where I'm signed in
me.description: Every browser where you are signed in now. End one you do not know, or sign out everywhere else.

held.onlyThis: Only this browser is signed in.

endOthers.title: Sign out everywhere else?
endOthers.what_one: 1 other session ends now. Unsaved work there is lost.
endOthers.what_other: {count} other sessions end now. Unsaved work there is lost.
endOthers.back: You can sign in again there at any time.

done.one: That session ended: the browser there is signed out.
done.others_one: 1 session ended: only this browser is signed in.
done.others_other: {count} sessions ended: only this browser is signed in.

person.title: Signed in now
person.description: Where this person is signed in: device, place, when the session started and when it was last used.

held.self: These are your own sessions: end them on My profile.
held.none: Not signed in anywhere: there is nothing to end.

confirm.title: End all of {name}'s sessions?
confirm.what_one: 1 session ends now: {name} is signed out everywhere. Unsaved work there is lost.
confirm.what_other: {count} sessions end now: {name} is signed out everywhere. Unsaved work there is lost.
confirm.again: They can sign in again at once. To keep them out, suspend the person.

person.historyLater: Sign-in history (time, country, device, method, result over 90 days) comes in a later wave.

failed.title: The settings could not be read
failed.body: The other sections keep working. Try again in a moment.

problem.invalid: Something is outside what is allowed: check the marked values.
problem.stale: Someone changed the settings meanwhile. They were read again: check them and save once more.
problem.forbidden: Changing these needs the right to change the security settings.
problem.unavailable: The factory server did not answer. Try again in a moment.
problem.failed: The change was not saved. Try again; if it happens again, tell the administrator.

lengths.title: Session lengths
lengths.hint: Per audience: how long a session lasts unused, and at the latest. A shorter length applies to every open session at its next request; a longer one to new sessions.

error.idleLongest: Cannot be longer than the longest session.

floor.none: No active site has floor settings yet.
floor.where: The floor's times are each site's own setting.

lengths.wider: Longer is wider: saving asks for a fresh code from your authenticator app.
lengths.rule: Shorter takes effect at once; longer asks for a fresh code.
lengths.viewOnly: You can read these. Changing them needs the right to change the security settings.
lengths.freshSentence: Longer sessions need a fresh code from your authenticator app.

done.shorter: Saved: every open session follows the new lengths at its next request.

fresh.title: Actions that ask for a fresh code
fresh.hint: Risky actions ask for a code from the authenticator app, even when signed in. The permissions behind each are listed; some always ask.

fixed.ACCESS: Always: a stolen session must never hand out rights.
fixed.SIGNATURE: Always: the fresh code is the signature's evidence.
fixed.LEGAL: Always: it reaches an authority or a customer for real.
fixed.RULE: Asked per approval rule: set on the rule itself.
fixed.SECURITY: Always: these settings guard everything else.

lock.title: Wrong codes
lock.failures: Wrong codes in a row before a lock
lock.minutesHint: Now: {now}. From {min} to {max}. Nobody can lift it earlier; signing in is never locked by it.

fresh.valid: A fresh code opens the risky actions for {minutes} minutes.
fresh.wider: Switching an action off, more wrong codes or a shorter lock is wider: saving asks for a fresh code.
fresh.rule: Switching an action on takes effect at once; switching one off asks for a fresh code.
fresh.freshSentence: Asking for fewer fresh codes needs a fresh code from your authenticator app.

done.stricter: Saved: the change applies at the next request.
done.wider: Saved: those actions no longer ask for a fresh code.

events.title: Security events
events.hint: Failed sign-ins, lockouts, two-factor changes, refusals, role changes and exports, newest first. For administrators and the Owner.

ip.label: IP address
ip.bad: Type a whole IPv4 or IPv6 address.

empty.title: No security events yet
empty.body: Sign-ins, refusals, role changes and exports show here as they happen.

events.rows: Rows only: never a count or a total per person. A floor worker is never named here.

change.security_setRoleTwoFactor: Two-factor rule of a role changed

one.title: Security event
one.workerHint: Floor workers are never named in the security events.
one.countryHint: From the address's country; the address itself is never kept.
one.relatedHint: Other events from the same address, within a day either side.
one.relatedNone: No other event from this address around then.

newRole.title: New role
newRole.hint: Start from a ready-made role, then name the copy. You change its permissions on its Permissions tab.
newRole.name: Name
newRole.nameHint: How the role shows in lists and to the people who hold it.
newRole.after: Creating asks for a fresh code. The copy holds only what you hold yourself.
newRole.readFailed: The ready-made roles could not be read

held.right: Making a role needs the right to create and edit custom roles.
held.fix: Pick a ready-made role and name the copy first.
held.owner: The owner's role is never copied: a custom role never holds everything.
held.beyond: Not offered: it holds rights you do not hold yourself.

error.basedOn: Pick the ready-made role to start from.
error.name: Type a name.

problem.beyond: The copy would hold rights you do not hold yourself.
problem.owner: A custom role never holds every office right: that is the owner's role.
problem.taken: A role with this name exists already: pick another name.
problem.forbidden: Making a role needs the right to create and edit custom roles.
problem.invalid: Something in it is not valid: check the name and try again.
problem.failed: The role was not made. Try again; if it happens again, tell the administrator.

newRole.freshSentence: Making a role needs a fresh code from your authenticator app.

saveRole.hint: Tick and untick, then Save: the review shows what changes and how many people get it.
saveRole.mfaWhy: A role that sees costs or margins always asks for two-factor: saving switches it on.
saveRole.atRest: No change yet: tick or untick what the role may do.
saveRole.title: Change role '{name}'?
saveRole.holders_one: 1 person gets this at their next request.
saveRole.holders_other: {count} people get this at their next request.
saveRole.asksCode: Raising rights asks for a fresh code.
saveRole.noCode: It only lowers rights: no fresh code is asked.
saveRole.risky: It asks for a fresh code itself.
saveRole.ack: I understand: the people who hold it get more rights at their next request.
saveRole.freshSentence: Raising a role's rights needs a fresh code from your authenticator app.

held.readyMade: A ready-made role follows its template: make a copy to change it.
held.archived: Archived: it changes no more and is given to nobody until it is restored.
held.right: Changing a role needs the right to create and edit custom roles.
held.mine: You hold this role: ask another administrator to change it.

refusal.beyondPermission: You do not hold “{permission}” yourself: a role never gives more than its maker holds.
refusal.beyondGrain: You do not see {grain} yourself: a role never gives more than its maker holds.
refusal.readyMade: A ready-made role cannot be changed: make a copy.
refusal.archived: This role is archived: restore it first.
refusal.held: You hold this role: ask another administrator.
refusal.lastAdmin: Nobody else could manage people and roles afterwards.
refusal.ownerEvery: A custom role never holds every office right: that is the owner's role.
refusal.mfaNeeded: A role that sees costs or margins must ask for two-factor.
refusal.mfaRule: The two-factor rule cannot change this way: see Scope rules.
refusal.name: The name is not valid.
refusal.content: A right in it cannot be given by an office role.
refusal.other: It cannot be saved as it is.

problem.refused: It was refused: see the reasons.
problem.stale: Someone changed this role meanwhile. It was read again: review it once more.
problem.forbidden: Changing a role needs the right to create and edit custom roles.
problem.failed: The change was not saved. Try again; if it happens again, tell the administrator.

archive.title: Archive role '{name}'?
archive.ends_one: 1 person loses it now: their assignment ends.
archive.ends_other: {count} people lose it now: their assignments end.
archive.frozen: An archived role changes no more and is given to nobody until it is restored. Restoring gives nobody anything back.
archive.reasonNeeded: Say why, in at least 3 characters.
archive.freshSentence: Archiving a role that people hold needs a fresh code from your authenticator app.
archive.refused: It was refused: you may hold it, or it makes the last administrators.
archive.done: Archived: it is given to nobody until it is restored.
archive.restored: Restored: it can be given and changed again.

reads.title: Who looked
reads.hint: Views, downloads and exports of sensitive records. For administrators and the Owner only; never used to judge anyone's work.

off.title: Views and downloads are not being logged here
off.body: The read log stays off until the staff privacy notice carries its line about it. Rows from before still show.

record.findHint: Type its number or name: cost sheets, employees, certificates, exports and the other sensitive records.
record.searchFailed: The search did not answer. Try again in a moment.

person.reasonHint: Kept in the person's history before anything is shown.
person.held: Looking by person needs the right to see the people.

error.reason: Say why, in at least 3 characters.

start.record: Find a record to see who looked at it.
start.person: Pick a person and say why to see what they looked at.

empty.title: Nobody looked
empty.body: No view, download or export is logged for this.
empty.off: Nothing is logged while the read log is off.

reads.rowsOnly: Rows only: never a count, a total or a group per person.

ip.label: IP address
ip.hint: The changes made in sessions signed in from this address.
ip.bad: Type a whole IPv4 or IPv6 address.
